subject: mathematics
general_outcomes: Demonstrate mastery of number concepts by working out problems in day-to-day life.
Apply measurement skills to find solutions to problems in a variety of contexts.
Apply properties of geometrical shapes and spatial relationships in real life experiences.
Apply data handling skills to solve problems in day-to-day life.
Analyze information using algebraic expressions in real life situations.
Apply mathematical ideas and concepts to other learning areas or learning areas and in real life contexts.
Develop confidence and interest in mathematics for further learning and enjoyment.
Develop values and competencies for a cohesive harmonious living in the society.
Manage pertinent and contemporary issues for enhanced inter-personal relationships.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to use place value and total value of digits up to hundreds of thousands.

assessment_rubric.approaches: The learner uses place value or total value of digits up to hundreds of thousands correctly.
assessment_rubric.below: The learner uses place value or total value of digits less than hundreds of thousands partially correct.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to read and write numbers up to tens of thousands in symbols and in words.
assessment_rubric.exceeds: The learner reads and writes numbers up to tens of thousands in symbols and in words correctly and proficiently.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to order and round off numbers up to tens of thousands.

assessment_rubric.below: The learner orders or rounds off numbers up to less than 10, 000 partially correct..

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to apply Least Common Multiple (LCM), Highest Common Factor (HCF), Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) and divisibility tests of 2, 5 and 10.

assessment_rubric.below: The learner applies one of the following: LCM, HCF, GCD or divisibility tests of 2, 5 and 10 correctly.

determine Highest Common Factor (HCF) and Greatest Common Divisor
in different situations
